GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, o.status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-08' AND DATE '2025-12-24')
)
SELECT 'lines' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) a, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) b, sum(CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order,
 sum(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) other_status, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM w
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups_by_receipt_line_dispatch_in_range', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)), 0,0,0,NULL,NULL FROM w WHERE dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'

calls.statement:
SELECT 'test_lines_web_dispatch_in_range' k, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) v
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test_returns_900', count(*), sum(-r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_900', count(*), sum(-r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'staff_web_lines', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.staff_purchase_flag AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_not_store900_with_WB', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<>900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders_processing_in_dec', count(*), sum(order_total_gross) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='processing'
